wider_means: A wider pinball machine is simply a wider cabinet and backbox with the same single playfield, wider side rails and a proportionally wider backglass and lockdown bar -- there is no second player station on a pinball machine.
taller_means: A taller pinball machine has longer legs and a taller plain lower cabinet body below the lockdown bar; the backbox and playfield stay the same size.

faults.fault: When the cabinet is widened the backbox texture tiles instead of extending: the score displays read '00.00' doubled and the backglass art is repeated/cut across the extra width. A wider machine gets one wider backglass, not two smeared halves.

Title sits fixed and centred while the backbox widens around it; the widened render shows the PINBALL lettering doubled and offset. Must stay one title, centred, with the panel extending at the ends.

faults.fault: At 1.3x wider the background panel behind the backbox stretches and repeats: the side-art decals and robot/rocket motifs appear doubled and smeared along the widened backbox, and streak bands run down the widened cabinet sides. A wider machine should have a proportionally wider backglass and side art, not mirrored echo copies.

At 1.5x taller the legs stretch far beyond a believable leg length and their texture streaks into vertical banding; the cross-members and leveller feet are smeared with them. The legs also visibly detach from the cabinet body, leaving stretched sliver geometry between body and floor.

At 1.5x taller the extra height goes almost entirely into the legs; the plain lower cabinet body below the lockdown bar stays the same height, so the silhouette is a normal cabinet perched on stilts instead of a taller cabinet. The stretched lower-panel texture bands and smears to compensate.
Small magenta debris polygons float clear of the body near the floor in both resized renders (1.3x and 1.5x) -- stray geometry a player could point at.
Same stretched, banded, detached leg geometry as leg_left at 1.5x; the foot smears out at the base instead of terminating cleanly.
Art does not scale across the wider backbox, leaving empty side borders.
